item_name: Rothco Nylon Police Baton With Grip
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Nylon Police Baton with Grip is designed for public safety professionals seeking reliable performance. Made from durable nylon fiberglass, this lightweight baton ensures a comfortable yet secure grip with its ergonomic rubber handle. Measuring 24 inches in length and 1.25 inches in diameter, it provides optimal reach and control for daily use. Whether for law enforcement, security, or self-defense, this baton is built for efficiency and long-lasting durability.
